cautions: About 150 m beside the Via da Surlej at the end: lead short for passing cars.
Forest tracks shared with mountain bikers: keep your dog close.
Meadows near Surlej are closed from 1 June until the end of the hay harvest: keep to the path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
